subject: Interactive rmarkdown document not displaying correctly after browser refresh

messages.author: 7fd94f18a52f6a93
messages.subject: Interactive rmarkdown document not displaying correctly after browser refresh
parts:
Hello,

I'm not sure if this is the correct group to post this, please let me know if there's another one better suited for this post. 

The problem I'm observing is that a interactive document built with rmarkdown displays incorrectly after refreshing the browser. This isn't such a big problem when running locally since I can just re-run it and it'll be fine again, however when deploying the document for sharing it using shinyserver that workaround isn't feasible. 

A full description of the problem along with a minimal reproducible example is in this stackoverflow question.

Thanks!

messages.author: 3da48b33a2f506a9
messages.subject: Re: Interactive rmarkdown document not displaying correctly after browser refresh
parts:
The example on the StackOverflow didn't show what you have on the top of your document (or may be that was the complete code). Please add the following to the top of document if you don't have it and try again:

---
title: "Untitled"
runtime: shiny
output: html_document
---

Best,
Fereshteh
